requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_DENORMAL(X) reports same-kind IEEE support
requirements.source: S17.11.53 p5 result value; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF508.
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_DENORMAL(X) is true exactly for real kind type parameters where IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) is true and arithmetic operations and assignments with subnormal numbers are supported; otherwise it is false.

pending.ieee_support_denormal-x-same-kind-suppor: Guarded branch plan: for each instantiated real kind rk, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DENORMAL(1.0_rk), IEEE_SUPPORT_DENORMAL([1.0_rk]), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0_rk), RADIX(1.0_rk), and DIGITS(1.0_rk); assert scalar and array probes agree and assert the true branch implies datatype support. True branch with RADIX=2 and DIGITS>=2 defines s = SCALE(1.0_rk, MINEXPONENT(1.0_rk)-DIGITS(1.0_rk)); hand check s is 2**(emin-digits), the smallest positive subnormal, and s+s is exactly SCALE(1.0_rk, MINEXPONENT(1.0_rk)-DIGITS(1.0_rk)+1). Under IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE guards for IEEE_CLASS observers, assert IEEE_CLASS(s) is IEEE_POSITIVE_SUBNORMAL, assignment through a sentinel preserves s exactly, and s+s equals the hand-derived next subnormal; false branch records skip for subnormal arithmetic and assignment effects.
